# Preparation

```{r}

ls.id <- "0407"
ls.type <- "imbalance_high"
file.ls <- paste0("../landscapes/", ls.type, "/data/", ls.id, ".rds")
ls <- readRDS(file.ls)
set.seed(1234)
ls.fit <- ls$landscape[sample(1:.N, 1e4), ]
```


```{r}
ggplot(ls$landscape) +
  geom_raster(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = response)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  map_guide_fill +
  map_theme
```


```{r}

som.egp <-
  egp_som(ls.fit,
          topo = "rectangular",
          x.dim = 25,
          y.dim = 25,
          epochs = 1000,
          vars = c("z1", "z2", "z3", "z4"),
          parallel = 4)

ls.fit[,
       c("som.unit", "som.x", "som.y") :=
         get_bmu(som.egp, coord = TRUE, list = TRUE)]

ls.fit[, type := factor(type, levels = levels(type), ordered = TRUE)]

```


# Classic EGP


```{r}

egp.k.geo <- 250
egp.max.knots.geo <- egp.k.geo * 10
egp.k.som <- 250
egp.max.knots.som <- 25^2

mod.egp <- bam(response ~
               s(x, y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)) +
               s(x, y, by = type, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)) +
               s(som.x, som.y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.som,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.som)),
               family = gaussian,
               data = ls.fit,
               select = TRUE,
               discrete = TRUE,
               nthreads = c(2,1))


egp.post <-
  egp_posterior_draw(mod.egp, 1000, unconditional = TRUE, package = "mgcv")


egp.pred <-
  egp_posterior_predict(model = mod.egp,
                        data = ls.fit,
                        id.var = "cell",
                        posterior = egp.post,
                        epred = FALSE)


egp.def <-
  egp_define_counterfactual(data = ls.fit,
                            som = som.egp,
                            fac.ids = ls.fit[type == "treatment", cell],
                            cf.ids = ls.fit[type == "reference", cell],
                            nb.strategy = "sequential",
                            group.by = list(NULL, "poly"),
                            som.var = "som.unit",
                            geo.vars = c("x", "y"),
                            geo.kernel = "matern32",
                            id.var = "cell",
                            deg.max = NULL,
                            n.min = 1)


egp.fac <- egp_evaluate_factual(egp.pred, egp.def, agg.size = 5e3)
egp.count <- egp_evaluate_counterfactual(egp.pred, egp.def, agg.size = 5e3)
egp.mar <- egp_marginal(egp.fac, egp.count)
```




```{r}

egp.mar.l <-
  melt(egp.mar,
       id.vars = c("group.id", "poly", ".draw"),
       variable.name = "cat",
       value.name = "estimate")

mar.true <-
  rbind(
    ls$landscape[type == "treatment",
                 .(marginal.true = mean(treatment))],
    ls$landscape[type == "treatment",
                 .(marginal.true = mean(treatment)),
                 by = "poly"
                 ][order(poly)],
    fill = TRUE)

egp.mar.l[cat != "marginal"] |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(x = cat,
                         y = estimate,
                         colour = cat),
                     scale = 0.8,
                     point_interval = "median_qi",

                     #  fatten_point = 1.5,

                     .width = c(0.5, 0.95)) +

        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(3, 14, 3, 3))
```

# New EGP


```{r}

egp.k.geo <- 250
egp.max.knots.geo <- egp.k.geo * 10
egp.k.som <- 250
egp.max.knots.som <- 25^2

ls.fit[, type.uo := factor(type, ordered = FALSE)]

mod.egp2 <- bam(response ~
               s(x, y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)) +
               s(som.x, som.y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.som,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.som)) +
               s(som.x, som.y, by = type, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)),
               family = gaussian,
               data = ls.fit,
               select = TRUE,
               discrete = TRUE,
               nthreads = c(2,1))

egp2.post <-
  egp_posterior_draw(mod.egp2, 1000, unconditional = TRUE, package = "mgcv")

colnames(egp2.post)


ls.u <-
  unique(ls.fit[type == "treatment" , .(cell, x, y, som.x, som.y)])

ls.pred <-
  merge(ls.u,
        CJ(cell = ls.u$cell,
           type = unique(ls.fit$type)))
ls.pred[, type.uo := factor(type, ordered = TRUE)]
ls.pred[, pred.id := 1:.N]


egp2.pred <-
  egp_posterior_predict(model = mod.egp2,
                        data = ls.pred,
                        id.var = "pred.id",
                        posterior = egp2.post,
                        epred = FALSE) |>
  merge(ls.pred)

egp2.comp <- 
  dcast(egp2.pred,
        cell + .draw ~ type, value.var = "response") |>
  merge(ls.fit[, .(cell, poly)], by = "cell")

egp2.mar <-
list(
  egp2.comp[,
            lapply(.SD, mean),
            .SDcols = c("treatment", "reference"),
            by = ".draw"],
  egp2.comp[order(poly),
            lapply(.SD, mean),
            .SDcols = c("treatment", "reference"),
            by = .(poly, .draw)]) |>
rbindlist(fill = TRUE)
egp2.mar[is.na(poly), group.id := 1]
egp2.mar[!is.na(poly), group.id := poly+1]

setnames(egp2.mar,
  c("treatment", "reference"),
  c("factual", "counterfactual"))

setcolorder(egp2.mar, c("group.id", "poly", ".draw"))

egp2.mar[, marginal := factual - counterfactual]


egp2.mar[, mean(marginal), by = "group.id"]
egp.mar[, mean(marginal), by = "group.id"]

egp2.mar[, sd(marginal), by = "group.id"]
egp.mar[, sd(marginal), by = "group.id"]

```



```{r}

library(brms)

brm()

check_ls <- function(lhat, lk) {
  lhat + 0.01 >= lk
}

calc_pars <- function(lk){
  ck <- max(4.1*lk, 1.2)
  mk <- round(3.42 * (ck/lk))
  list(lk = lk, ck = ck, mk = mk)
}

pars.geo <- calc_pars(0.5)
pars.geo <- calc_pars(0.06)


pars.som <- calc_pars(0.5)
pars.som <- calc_pars(0.11)

set.seed(1234)
ls.fit2 <- ls.fit[sample(1:.N, 1e3)]

mod.brm <-
  brm(response ~ 
        gp(x, y, k = pars.geo$mk, cov = "matern32", c = pars.geo$ck) +
        gp(som.x, som.y, k = pars.som$mk, cov = "matern32", c = pars.som$ck),
      data = ls.fit2,
      family = gaussian,
      cores = 4,
      chains = 4,
      iter = 2000,
      warmup = 1000
      )

summary(mod.brm)

nei.cor <- function(h,n) { ## construct nei structure
  nei <- list(md=1:n,d=1:n)
  nei$ma <- cumsum(c((h+1):(2*h+1),rep(2*h+1,n-2*h-2),(2*h+1):(h+1)))
  a0 <- rep(0,0); if (h>0) for (i in 1:h) a0 <- c(a0,1:(h+i))
  a1 <- n-a0[length(a0):1]+1
  nei$a <- c(a0,1:(2*h+1)+rep(0:(n-2*h-1),each=2*h+1),a1)
  nei
}

neic <- nei.cor(4, 20)

neic


lhat + 0.01 >= lk

```



```{r}

library(RANN)

coord <- as.matrix(ls.fit[, .(x, y)])

nei <-
  nn2(coord, coord, k = 11, radius = 100, searchtype = "radius")


exidx <- function(x) {
  x[x != 0 & x != x[1]]
}

nei.l <- apply(nei$nn.idx, 1, exidx, simplify = FALSE)

nei <-
  list(d = 1:nrow(ls.fit),
       md = 1:nrow(ls.fit),
       a = unlist(nei.l),
       ma = cumsum(unlist(lapply(nei.l, length))),
       )
# nei$sample <- sample(nei$ma, 1000)
# nei$sample <- sample(1:length(nei$ma), 100)

nei$ma


egp.k.geo <- 250
egp.max.knots.geo <- egp.k.geo * 10
egp.k.som <- 250
egp.max.knots.som <- 25^2


mod.egp2 <- gam(response ~
               s(x, y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)) +
               s(x, y, by = type, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.geo,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.geo)) +
               s(som.x, som.y, bs = "gp", k = egp.k.som,
                 xt = list(max.knots = egp.max.knots.som)),
               family = gaussian,
               data = ls.fit,
               method = "NCV",
               nei = nei,
               # discrete = TRUE,
               control = gam.control(trace = TRUE),
               nthreads = c(2,1))

egp2.post <-
  egp_posterior_draw(mod.egp2, 1000, unconditional = TRUE, package = "mgcv")


egp2.pred <-
  egp_posterior_predict(model = mod.egp2,
                        data = ls.fit,
                        id.var = "cell",
                        posterior = egp2.post,
                        epred = FALSE)


egp2.def <-
  egp_define_counterfactual(data = ls.fit,
                            som = som.egp,
                            fac.ids = ls.fit[type == "treatment", cell],
                            cf.ids = ls.fit[type == "reference", cell],
                            nb.strategy = "sequential",
                            group.by = list(NULL, "poly"),
                            som.var = "som.unit",
                            geo.vars = c("x", "y"),
                            geo.kernel = "matern32",
                            id.var = "cell",
                            deg.max = NULL,
                            n.min = 1)


egp2.fac <- egp_evaluate_factual(egp2.pred, egp2.def, agg.size = 5e3)
egp2.count <- egp_evaluate_counterfactual(egp2.pred, egp2.def, agg.size = 5e3)
egp2.mar <- egp_marginal(egp2.fac, egp2.count)


egp2.mar[, mean(marginal), by = "poly"]
egp.mar[, mean(marginal), by = "poly"]
```
